messages:
Rae: Heads-up: copy for the unsaved-changes confirmation in the Eval editor feels abrupt. Current modal: "Discard changes?" Body: "You have unsaved edits. Discard and lose changes?" Primary: "Discard" Secondary: "Cancel". Feels terse and a bit accusatory. Ideas for softer wording?

Omar: Agree. We should signal permanence and give a clear recovery path if possible. Also enterprise folks might expect auto-save info.

Priya: From a UI POV buttons need to be short but explicit. On small screens we use single-line buttons, so keep labels <= 12 chars ideally.

Rae: Draft A: Title: "Discard unsaved edits" Body: "You have unsaved edits to this eval. If you discard them now, your changes will be lost.

  • Save changes
  • Discard changes

Primary: "Save and close" Secondary: "Discard"

Rae: Rationale: make save the safer default and explicit about loss.

Noah: Accessibility: primary should be programmatically first for keyboard, but visual order can be secondary-first if that matches patterns. Also include aria-describedby pointing to the body so screen readers get the context (e.g., aria-describedby="unsaved-body"). Avoid ambiguous single-word CTAs for screen readers.

Claire: Product note: we do autosave drafts for editors, but eval runs aren't auto-saved by default. We should surface that: "Note: eval runs are not auto-saved" as helper text. That reduces support tickets.

Priya: Implementation suggestion: keep two actions but label them: Primary: "Save changes" (safe), Secondary: "Discard changes". On mobile use shorter "Save" / "Discard" with aria-labels that expand intent.

Rae: Updated copy (final candidate): Title: "Unsaved changes" Body: "You have unsaved edits to this evaluation. Eval runs are not auto-saved.
  • Save your changes to keep them
  • Discard to discard edits and close

Primary: "Save changes" (aria-label="Save changes and close editor") Secondary: "Discard changes" (aria-label="Discard edits and close editor") Helper text: "Tip: you can export a draft before discarding."

Noah: +1. Make sure body uses a list for the two options so AT reads them as separate items. Helper text should be low-contrast but meet AA (12px). Also move focus to the modal close trap but default to the primary button.

Omar: Approved. Also add analytics event: eval_unsaved_modal_choice with property choice = {save, discard}.

Priya: I'll push a small PR to the modal component with the new copy and aria attributes. Will use short mobile labels and aria-labels as discussed.

Rae: Thanks! Tag me on the PR for a quick copy sign-off. :smile:
